name: Section-Row Compatibility Criterion
statement: For pieces $A_j$ with common section $D$, pairwise disjoint private coordinate blocks, and downward closure in each private block, the embedded union $X$ has positive margin exactly when the positive extension spaces of their minimal-missing-pattern rows on $D$ have a common member. If one row family extends to a $t$-certificate of every piece, then $t^2/(1+2t)\le\mu(X)\le\min_j\mu(A_j)$.
proof: Restriction proves necessity. For sufficiency, shrink the witness in the occupied piece and set every unoccupied private coordinate to $-1$. Downward closure makes those negative values help every private row; cross-block missing pairs use uniform rows.
